articleTitle: Design of a Multiport Bidirectional DC-DC Converter for Low Power PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: In this paper, a non-isolated multi-input multi-output DC-DC converter for low power PV applications is proposed. The designed converter provides different voltage levels at the output with inter-source power sharing and bidirectional power flow capability. Steady state analysis of different operating modes based on the direction of power flow is discussed. Moreover, a double loop PI control structure is applied that provides a regulated output voltage and current at the output irrespective of input voltage variation. The mathematical analysis and circuit architecture is validated through simulation results that prove the feasibility of proposed topology.

articleTitle: Short Transmission Line Parameter Estimation Using Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: The transmission line is a vital part of an electric power network. Precise knowledge about the parameters of a transmission line is important to perform power system operation, control and, to design a line protection system. This paper puts forward a method to estimate parameters of a transmission line based on a short transmission line model and the line input-output data such as voltage, current, power and/or power factor at each end of the line. The firefly algorithm, a swarm intelligence optimization technique, is used to estimate parameters of the line model by defining an error minimization objective function. It is concluded that the presented approach is significant in estimating the line parameters with high accuracy. The estimated parameters are in precision with the actual line parameters indicated by the low relative error.

articleTitle: Performance Benchmark of Multi-Layer Neural Network Based Solar MPPT for PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: A multi-layer feed-forward ANN-based approach is discussed in this paper to achieve maximum power point tracking (MPPT). 70% of the data-set is trained with ANN algorithm, 15% is used for validation and 15% is utilized in testing of neural network. The photo generated output power after MPPT is interfaced with photovoltaic (PV) converters and subsequently to the solar-driven lead-acid battery charge controllers. The research effort aims to have a comparative performance analysis of the ANN approach against the well-known Perturb and Observe algorithm (P&O) and incremental inductance considering MPPT effectiveness for the PV modules and the charging and discharging response of the lead-acid based battery. The simulation results reveal that the neural network algorithm-based approach is more effective than the conventional algorithms for solar MPPT to mitigate the mismatch losses due to partial shading condition as well as for achieving the optimal efficiency of PV battery charge controllers and the overall PV system.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Consequent Pole Dual Stator Hybrid Excited Linear Flux Switching Machine for Rail Transit System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: In this paper, a Consequent Pole Dual Stator Hybrid Excited Linear Flux Switching Machine (CP-DHELFSM) with characteristics of high thrust density of permanent magnet (PM) motor and flux regulation capability of field excited machines is proposed. The proposed design has all excitation sources on short mover having completely passive secondary, which makes it prominent candidate for rail transit systems. CP-DHELFSM provides an improved magnetic flux regulation capability under various magnetic field currents while reducing the PM volume by 33%. More importantly, by placing PM in the magnetization direction opposite to the leakage flux, the mover leakage flux is eliminated. Single variable optimization is used to optimize the various design parameters such as split ratio, width of PM inside h-tooth, width of flux bridge and stator pole width while keeping the slot area, electric and magnetic loading constant. The optimized design has improved peak to peak flux linkage up to 43.02%, average thrust force (T F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">avg</inf>) up to 41 %, thrust force density (T F D) up to 40.54 %, reduced thrust force ripples (T F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rip</inf>) up to 36.28%.

articleTitle: A Modified Inertia Weight Control of Particle Swarm Optimization for Optimal Reactive Power Dispatch Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Appropriate determination of control variables of Optimal Reactive Power Dispatch Problem (ORPD) are essential for optimal power flow in power system. An improved inertia weight strategy of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is presented to determine the optimal control variables (both continuous and discrete) of ORPD. Inertia weight of conventional PSO is not able to provide optimum weight between local and global search phase hence, causes premature convergence and trap in local minima. In this paper an improved inertia weight strategy is adopted to avoid trapping in local minima and premature convergence of conventional PSO. The proposed approach is examined/validated on IEEE 14 and 30-bus system. The comparative analysis of obtained results depicts that proposed approach effectively reduces the active power loss by providing optimum control variables and can be employed for complex and highly dimensional problems.

articleTitle: Improved Selective Harmonics Elimination Strategy for Multilevel Inverters with Optimal DC Values
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper examines the computation of optimal DC values and switching angles for eliminating higher order harmonics in Cascaded Multi-Level Inverters (CMLI) output voltage using Nelder Mead (NM) Simplex Algorithm. The goal is to solve the set of non-linear Selective Harmonic Elimination (SHE) equations in order to obtain the required fundamental component as well as eliminate the higher order harmonics. 2- and 3-stage CMLI for single and three phase output is investigated with equal and unequal DC sources and harmonics efficient suppression is reported. Superiority of NM method over Genetic Algorithm and Generalized Search Pattern with respect to convergence and computational time to reach the global minimum is discerned and demonstrated through MATLAB simulations. Results manifest that NM convergence rate and computational time is faster than GPS and GA for identical population of test points. For validation of results, 2- and 3-stage inverter is simulated in MATLAB Simulink for FFT analysis.

articleTitle: Novel Partitioned Primary Linear Hybrid Excited Flux Switching Machine with Segmented Secondary
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel segmented secondary partitioned primary hybrid excited linear flux switching machine (PP-HELFSM) for long stroke applications. In recent years, the price of rare earth permanent magnets (such as NdFeB) has risen rapidly. Therefore, great attention is paid to substitute the existing magnet materials. This article compares the proposed machine for different magnet materials; one uses NdFeB and other uses a less expensive ferrite magnets. The proposed machine is a double-mover with partitioned primary structure. PM and the field winding are placed in a lower primary and armature winding is placed on the upper primary, to avoid the problem of crowded primary in single sided machines. PMs are placed between the E shaped cores of the lower primary. The electromagnetic properties like flux linkages, back EMF, detent force and thrust force of the proposed machine is investigated. The influence of both magnets ferrite and NdFeB are analysed and compared. The NdFeB indicates higher thrust force at the same electric loading but have high thrust ripples.

Author Keywords: Hybrid excited linear flux switching machine

articleTitle: Reactive Power Compensation Utilizing FACTS Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Efficient control of reactive power flow is required to maintain a stable system operation. Insufficient reactive power support may lead to system instability, incurring higher losses. Power systems frequently come across voltage level violations due to the fluctuating load that results in under or over compensation of reactive power. In this paper the effectiveness of FACTS devices is studied in the actual power system of an industry. Comparison between three different techniques is made in terms of analyzing system parameters i.e. reactive power support, power factor, and system losses. Three of the FACTS devices namely SVC, STATCOM and UPFC are implemented and their effectiveness is compared to provide a benchmark study of FACTS devices.

articleTitle: A Novel Double-Sided Linear Flux Switching Machine with Yokeless Secondary for Long Stroke Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: This article introduces a novel double-sided linear hybrid excitation flux switching machine (DSLHEFSM) with yokeless secondary suitable for long stroke applications. The significant to this novel machine is the elimination of the secondary yoke, which can reduce the volume of the secondary. To reduce cost, ferrite magnets with reduced volume as compared to conventional design are utilized. In order to increase the thrust force density and reduce thrust force ripple under load conditions, the impact of some main design parameters, including split ratio, AC winding slot area, stator pole alignment, stator pole width, stator pole height and turn-on angle are investigated through finite element analysis. The electromagnetic performances of the LHEFSM are analysed including flux linkage, detent force, normal force, no-load EMF, force-velocity curve. Within the same volume constraint and electrical loading, the proposed model achieved higher average thrust force than the conventional model.

Author Keywords: Hybrid excited linear flux switching machine

articleTitle: Small Signal Modelling and Observer based Stability Analysis of Cuk Converter via Lyapunov's Direct Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper proposed a state observer for the Cuk converter to estimate its unknown states for controlling different parameters of the Cuk converter. Moreover, a Lyapunov direct approach is used to establish the stability condition for the proposed observer. A small signal dynamical model of the DC-DC Cuk converter is considered for precise estimation of different states of the Cuk converter by using the state-space average model-based technique. The state observer has been evaluated in SMC based control structure for a Cuk converter. The designed observer can estimate all states of the Cuk converter without extra sensor requirements, which makes it reliable to overcome sensor noise problems. The Lyapunov direct scheme ensured the asymptomatic stability of observer states to actual states of the Cuk converter average model. The experimental results authenticate the performance of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Effect of fixed and seasonal tilt angles on the performance of an ON-Grid PV plant
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Worldwide, all the countries are moving towards renewable energy sources to cater their energy demands. For Pakistan, solar energy is one of the best options among renewable energy resources and is free from air pollution and fuel usage. The main objective of present study is the performance comparative analysis of 1MW grid-connected PV power plant for Silver star industry at Sialkot (Longitude 74.42* E & Latitude 32.36* N) using fixed angle and seasonal tilt angle technology. The average solar radiation at plant site is 4.55 kWh/m2/day and the average annual temperature is 25.18 °C. The actual measured results of the PV power plant are compared with the results acquired by doing simulations at fixed angle and at seasonal tilt angles using PV syst software. The PV plant is installed at fixed angle 30° and the optimal seasonal tilt angles found by doing simulations are 14° and 46°. From the comparative study, it is observed that 5.28% energy generation is increased by using seasonal tilt angles as compared to actual PV plant energy generation. Moreover, the performance parameters including final yield, performance ratio and capacity utilization factor increases to 4.6%, 1.6% and 5.3% respectively, by using seasonal tilt angle as compared to actual fixed angle of the PV plant. The comparative results indicated that the seasonal tilt angle can play a significant role in improving the performance of On-Grid PV plant.

articleTitle: Feasibility and analysis of MMC-based UHVDC for a case study of Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: In residential and industrial areas AC is mostly used because it is easy to step up to higher voltage levels using the transformers. But AC is expensive when the transmission distance is greater than 500 kilometers or above and AC has limitations to transmit power at longer distances. High Voltage DC (HVDC) has no limitations of transmission distance. HVDC technology is a technology to transmit bulk power at longer distances. The purpose of this research is to transmit power of 4000MW from Matiari (Sindh, Pakistan) to Lahore (Punjab, Pakistan). Mostly load centres in Pakistan are situated in the centre of the country while sources of power are situated in the North and the South regions of the Pakistan. This research comprises of economic and feasibility analysis of UHVDC for a project named as Matiari. This analyses the HVDC and UHVDC. Simulations and experimental results are carried out by using MATLAB (Matrix Laboratory). To transmit power Bipolar links are adopted. Eleven levels modular multilevel converter (MMC) technology is adopted to convert power. In case of Matiari rectifier end will be in Matiari and inverting end will be in Lahore. The THD analysis of 3-level VSC and Eleven levels MMC is analyzed using the FFT analysis. The inverter side faults are also analyzed.

articleTitle: Water Absorption Resistance Study of HTV Silicone Rubber-Based Hybrid Composites
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Silicone rubber-based insulating polymers are extensively used in high voltage outdoor applications due to their high hydrophobicity and better withstand performance. However, the main problem with polymeric composites is their aging due to external environmental stresses (e.g. direct sunlight, high humidity and temperatures, ultraviolet radiations, etc.) as well as strength of the applied electrical field. In the present work, for examining weight gain, hydrophobicity, and hardness, five different types of HTV silicone rubber-based hybrid composites are prepared. All the samples are reinforced with micro-alumina (20 wt. %) and different concentrations of silica fillers. Material samples are immersed in distilled and boiling water for 24h and 2h, respectively. For analysis, hydrophobicity, weight gain and hardness tests are conducted. The results of the performed tests indicated that the sample filled with 6 wt. % of nano-silica has less percentage gain in weight due to water absorption compared to the other hybrid composites. The sample with the same composition showed high hydrophobicity as well.

articleTitle: Optimal On-Grid Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid for a Small Village in Muzaffargarh District, Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: The socio-economic development of our rural areas is mainly affected by the shortage of electricity that is carried out in these remote areas. This situation can be readily mitigated by utilizing renewable energy resources present in these areas so that a continuous supply of energy is maintained. In this study, a combined hydro and Solar renewable energy system is proposed for a small village in Muzaffargarh District at Muzaffargarh-Garhmor road near the TP-Link canal, Pakistan. A combined micro-hydro and solar system is proposed that is capable of meeting the energy requirements in this specific village by utilizing the existing energy resources available. Moreover, the continuous supply of electrical energy is ensured by integrating this Hybrid Energy System (HES) with the local area grid station. The proposed system along with satisfactorily fulfilling the energy demands of this area ensured the cheap production of electricity at the rate of 0.0438 $/kWh. The system efficiency can be easily judged by the fact that the proposed system in this study is capable of generating electricity even cheaper than the energy supplied by the grid.

articleTitle: Vector Proportional Integral Controller in Series Connected Custom Power Device for Voltage Quality Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) is one of the most efficient and economical series connected custom power device having a major application in Power Quality Enhancement at consumer and distribution level. In the control structure, the DVR usually utilizes rotating reference frame, which comes with certain downsides. Main purpose of this study is to execute a performance analysis on both rotating and stationary reference frame based DVR's. Cascaded controllers with an outer voltage controller and an inner current controller have been used as control strategy. As current controllers, both Proportional Integral (PI) and Vector Proportional Integral (VPI) controllers are used separately to compare their performance using MATLAB/Simulink. This comparative analysis has been carried out by considering settling time, overshoot and error signals for linear as well as non-linear loads while taking the computational time delays into account.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling and Thermal Analysis of Evacuated Flat Plate Collector in Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Energy is a key parameter for a country's development. From recent decades Pakistan is facing energy crises due to the limitation of traditional energy resources. In Pakistan, natural gas, electricity, and coal are used for domestic hot water systems and industrial process heat. Due to climate change, traditional energy resources are declining, and energy demand is increasing. To support the developmental work, increasing population, and industries, Pakistan will need energy in an abundant amount to run the system on the proper track. To solve these problems, we just need to replace traditional energy resources with renewable energy. Solar thermal collectors are sources to complete the demand for hot water on small and large scales. This paper demonstrates an evacuated flat plate collector having an area of 4 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and working fluid water-glycol mixture inside the tubes circulates with different mass flow rates of 0.01 to 0.1 kg/s with the help of a pump. The vacuum is created inside the collector with the help of a vacuum pump and pressure maintained less than 1 bar. Program is generated in MATLAB and simulated under design conditions of the collector with input weather data collected from meteorological high precision equipment installed at US-PCASE, NUST Islamabad, Pakistan having a latitude of 33.64° N and longitude of 72.99° E. By evacuating the enclosure convective losses from plate to cover are drastically reduced, which in turn decreases overall heat loss coefficient from 7.50 to 4.60 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>K. absorber temperature is also increased due to reduction of convective losses, which in turn increases fluid outlet temperature by 7 to 9 °C and also increases the efficiency of the collector by 7 % as compared to non-evacuated flat plate collectors.

articleTitle: Thermal and Stress Analysis of Linear Hybrid Excited Flux Switching Machine with Modular Stator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Performance of electrical machine greatly varies with its operating temperature and amount of stress it is experiencing. To evaluate the performance and working of Linear Hybrid Excited Flux Switching Machine (LHEFSM) thermal analysis is performed. JMAG (FEA package) is used to analyze thermal behaviour of the machine which is then validated by equivalent magnetic circuit using Lumped Parametric Model (LPMC). Developed model is simulated using SIMULINK and is then compared with the FEA analysis. A good agreement between the two is observed with a percentage error of less than 3%. In the end stress analysis of the mover is performed and the resulting stress is evaluated at different mover speed.

articleTitle: Modelling and Experimental Analysis of a Novel Evacuated Tubes based Parabolic Trough Solar Collector for Water Heating Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Solar thermal energy is clean, most promising and abundant renewable energy source. A solar collector collects radiation from the sun and converts these radiation into heat, which is then transferred to working fluid. The purpose of this study was to design, fabricate and analyse an energy efficient and cost effective parabolic trough solar collector with evacuated tube mounted on its focal axis to obtain hot water. A mathematical model of the system was developed and required dimensions of parabolic trough solar collector and copper tubes placed inside evacuated tubes were determined. The whole system was designed to operate on solar energy by improved focused radiations onto water carrying copper tubes to maximize outlet temperature. An arrangement of parabolic trough solar collectors connected in series was fabricated. The inlet feed temperature of water was 35°C and then it was heated to a range of temperatures between 35 °C and 70°C depending upon the required flow rate. Solar system was analysed for various operating parameters and their results signified that performance of collector was greatly affected by the intensity of solar radiations which changes throughout the day. Moreover, impact of different radial positions of tubes on the collector performance was also analysed.

articleTitle: Three Phase Transformer Based Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper presents a three phase nine-level transformer based cascaded H-bridge (CHB) modular multilevel inverter. Each single-phase module consists of two cascaded H-bridge circuits, having only eight switches and a transformer for efficient and cost-effective voltage conversion. This will lead to fewer number of switches and lower filtering requirement to generate multilevel output. For the switching logic, multiple modulation techniques are reviewed, such as Level-shift, Carrier-based and Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation technique (SVPWM. An improvised switching pattern is applied and multilevel voltage output is demonstrated with the aid of mathematical model and simulations.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Five Phase Nonoverlapping Stator Wound Field Flux switching Machine for Torque Performance Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper describes the design, analysis and optimization of five phase wound field flux switching (WFFS) machine having the non-overlap winding configuration and design analysis is briefly discussed in terms of flux linkage, back EMF, flux strengthening, cogging torque, average torque. The optimization of the initial machine is performed to enhance the average output torque and minimize the torque ripples while motor size is kept constant. In optimization process, krigging method specified with Latin Hyper-cube Sampling and a genetic algorithm (GA) is executed due to appropriateness with non-linear data. Then, results are verified through finite element analysis by JMAG-Designer. It is observed that optimized model has obtained 12.8% increase in average output torque and 22.71% torque ripples reduction as compared to the initial model. Finally, electromagnetic performances verify the reliability of the optimized model.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Performance Analysis of Modular Segmented Permanent Magnet Consequent Pole Flux Switching Machine Employing Flux Gap
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Permanent Magnet (PM) Flux Switching machines (PMFSMs) are durable applicants for high speed brushless application due to high torque and power density. However, despite of excessive PM usage and leakage flux, conventional PMFSMs are not excellent fault tolerant. To overcome the abovesaid shortcomings, this paper introduces Modular Segmented Permanent Magnet Consequent Pole Flux Switching Machine (MSPMCPFSM) which reduces PM volume by 46.54% utilizing segmented PM configuration and added fault tolerant capability by introducing flux gap in stator. Moreover, influence of the Flux Gap (FG) is investigated on electromagnetic performance. Analysis concludes that FG offers physical partitioned between phases to limit fault propagation during fault condition between each phase. In additional, with the increase in FG, phase self-inductance increases that mitigates short circuit current at higher speed whereas mutual inductance is suppressed to avoid mutual coupling of faulty and healthy phases. Finally, developed MSPMCPFSM is compared with conventional PMFSMs topologies. Analysis concluded that at reduced PM, MSPCPFSM exhibits 2.6 times higher torque density, and 3.81 times more power density with excellent fault tolerant capability.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring and Index Based Maintenance Scheduling of Domestic Gasoline Generators for loss Reduction Using Android Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper focuses on objective to get the real time data of the generator that will help the user to monitor the generator health and need of maintenance. Domestic consumers do not look over and study every detail in the instruction manual that they get with the generator and so, don't do preventive maintenance on their generator which results in breakdown. The designed system constantly monitors the generator, and helps to prevent damages. This system is specifically designed for household generators that run on gasoline, ranging up to 5KVA. The system consists of six different sensors being placed at different places on generator, through these sensors real time monitoring is done and data appear in the application with maintaining log of each activity. The data collected by the sensor is forwarded through Wi-Fi-module and is further sent to android application that alerts the user every time if the generator needs maintenance. The preventive maintenance based on grading index algorithm that shows alerts whenever the maintenance or ambiguity arises. By applying the designed system reduce maintenance issues and increase the life of generator, moreover with special feature it can count running along with that it measures the CO emissions.

articleTitle: Rotor Pole Based Dual Stator Hybrid Excitation of Flux Switching Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper briefly presents Dual Stator Hybrid Excitation of Flux Switching Motor (DSHEFSM) having three rotor poles of various number and designs. Source of flux are limited stator, making the rotor fully passive which suits the highspeed applications. Detailed summary of no load and full load analysis is in the main section of DSHEFSM. DSHEFSM feasibility design experiments based on 2D- FEA is analyzed using the proposed machine is three phase behavior. Moreover, the coil test analysis, magnetic flux characteristic, cogging torque, induced voltage at open circuit condition, torque versus armature current, and instantaneous torque are analyzed.

articleTitle: Fault detection and identification in MVDC Radial and Ring Distribution System by Wavelet decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: The use of renewable energy systems (RES), as distributed generation (DG) units, in distribution systems is growing in recent years. DC distribution system is more feasible for the integration of renewable energy-based DGs as compared to the AC Distribution system. In DC distribution protection is the main issue because of low line impedance that causes high fault current. In this paper wavelet decomposition based protection scheme is proposed which identify the fault section in the distribution system and also identify which type of fault is occurred. Voltage and current signals, both are analyzed through wavelet. Sequence voltages are used for the input signal to wavelet decomposition for fault type identification. A communication channel is used between lines relays for the identification of faulty sections in distribution. A bipolar ring and radial type DC distribution systems are modeled on MATLAB/Simulink and different fault events are simulated.

articleTitle: Micro-Hydro Coordinated Strategy With Battery Energy Storage System Towards Cost Effective Load Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Transmission and distribution of electricity to hilly areas in Pakistan is an issue. Government is trying to sort out this problem by constructing micro-hydro units. However, It is difficult for this stand-alone micro-hydro generating unit to provide continuous and cost effective electricity to end consumers. In this research, a new coordinated strategy will be developed in which energy will be stored in battery energy storage system (BESS) at off-peak load time under constrained power where the cost of electricity will also be low. The stored energy will be utilized at peak time where demand of electricity will be high. This will ensure cost effective and continuous supply of green energy to end consumers. The developed problem is binary integer linear programming (BILP) type. The branch and bound (B&B) algorithm is applied along with coordination strategy to solve the proposed problem. In this paper, optimal time slot allocations of different electrical appliances are obtained under constrained power which will also lower the bill of electricity. The simulation results will show the effectiveness of this proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Modeling and Implementation of a Photovoltaic Solar Panel in ATPdraw
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: The utilization of distributed generation has grown each year as an alternative for diversification of energetic matrix in many countries. In this scenario, as a clean alternative, photovoltaic generation is one of the most promising sources of energy, currently having several studies and analysis about its operation and performance. Therefore, this work shows a modeling and implementation of the operation of a photovoltaic panel in the ATPdraw software, where the results obtained were compared to real data from a panel. The software used has a great advantage in the implementation and simulation of electrical events, through existing components in it, or the creation of new ones through mathematical equations. With this, through a mathematical model, it was implemented through equations, a component that represents the real characteristics of a photovoltaic panel.

articleTitle: A sparrow search optimization algorithm based MPPT control of PV system to harvest energy under uniform and non-uniform irradiance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: To meet the increasing demand of energy, photovoltaic (PV) systems are viable solution but weather changing conditions cause PV systems to fall into partial shading (PS) category which makes the maximum power point (MPP) to be non-linear. Conventional MPPT techniques effectively tracks MPP under uniform irradiance level but fails under nonuniform irradiance levels. Many bio-inspired MPPT control techniques are presented in literature but drawbacks observed in these techniques are high tracking time, oscillations at global maxima (GM) and falling in local maxima (LM) trap under PS. A novel sparrow search algorithm (SSA) based MPPT control technique is presented in this paper. Enhancement in performance of PV systems, less convergence time, little or no oscillations around global maxima (GM) are improvements observed in the proposed technique during comparative analysis with other bio inspired techniques. These enhancements are also validated with experimental setup by implementing proposed technique on low cost microcontroller. Comparison also shows the tracking of GM of proposed technique with high efficiency greater than 99.98%, up to 50% less tracking time and zero oscillations at GM under PS conditions. Superiority of proposed technique in terms of sensitivity, solidity and cogency is presented using statistical analysis.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Management for a two-area system (Thermal-PV & Hydel-PV) by Swarm Optimization based Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Load Frequency Control (LFC) has become of crucial importance in modern power systems on account of varying demand and generation trends. To maintain the frequency variations and minimize the tie line power fluctuations, various soft computing techniques have been used for fine tuning of PID controller in LFC problems. This paper presents a comparative analysis of various swarm optimization-based intelligent algorithms for LFC problems. From simulation results obtained via Simulink (MATLAB), the frequency variations in each area, tie-line power fluctuation profile as well as the convergence trend for each algorithm has been analyzed in this paper. Besides various system parameters such as percentage overshoot, settling time, rise timeand steady state error, different performance indices have also been computed against each swarm intelligence-based algorithm.

articleTitle: Home Energy Management Strategy for DR Accomplishment Considering PV Uncertainties and Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Overpopulation has adverse effects on increasing energy consumption. This energy demand is so much that the traditional grid is unable to sustain energy supply. To meet this demand, battery energy storage and distributed generation sources are important in maintaining a constant energy supply. This paper minimizes the residential customer's energy cost with PV, battery storage system, and home to grid energy exchange. The results show how much home to grid energy exchange is important in reducing cost. A complete home energy management (HEM) system is explored, incorporating PV, battery storage system, and home to grid energy exchange. The cuckoo search (CS) optimization algorithm uses a residential home's data and develops optimal running of appliances. The results obtained from the algorithm depicts that the approach is beneficial and useful for the residential consumer to initiate different DR actions. The cost associated is reduced, and energy utilization is very efficient in the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Passive Islanding Detection using Square Law Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Islanding detection has a very important role in power systems because it addresses many safety problems. A novel passive method for islanding identification in a distributed system is proposed in this paper. The proposed framework is discussed in two folds. In the first fold, the modal signal is calculated from a three-phase current, and its envelope is generated using a square law device (SLD). In the second fold, variance in autocorrelation of modal current envelop (VAMCE) is utilized as a detection basis for islanding. The autocorrelation function (ACF) of modal current (MC) envelop yields various transient features, which are then used to discriminate between the islanding and non-islanding situations. The smaller non detection zone (NDZ) and accuracy are the key advantages of this method. The VAMCE varies negligibly in normal conditions, however it varies significantly during islanding conditions, making this scheme a very effective tool for the detection of island. The scheme is evaluated using several simulations under different conditions, normal and islanded. It is found that the proposed scheme is quick and has better accuracy in comparison to other passive techniques.

articleTitle: Prospects of Vertical Axis Wind Turbines for Urban Electrification in Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: In the modern world wind energy is becoming a significant part of the energy mix in developed countries of Asia, Europe, and America. Importantly, China has installed wind turbines, which is almost half of the world's installed wind power capacity. Similarly, Denmark is producing 42% of its total electricity from wind. Currently, Pakistan is experiencing an acute level of electricity shortage, which causes blackouts of several hours per day. Furthermore, due to modernization, the electricity demand is increasing rapidly as compared to the installed capacity of electricity generation. Therefore, to cope with rising electricity demand without harming the environment, a smooth transition from thermal towards renewable energy is required. One short-term alternative to meet the uprising electricity demand is to allow the community to produce electric power by wind energy. Fortunately, Pakistan has enormous wind energy potential. The total extractable wind power capacity is 120 GW. Urban cities like Karachi, Hyderabad and Quetta have an average wind speed of 3-4.5 m/s at 10-meter height, which is best suitable for small scale Vertical Axis Wind Turbines (VAWT). Like, India, Brazil and other developing countries, Pakistan should take measures to utilize the VAWT technology for electricity production at a community level.

articleTitle: Radial Basis Function trained with Dynamic Differential Annealed Optimization algorithm based Maximum Power Point Tracking Control of PV system under Uniform and Non-Uniform irradiance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Emerging Power Technologies (ICEPT)
abstract: Excessive use of fossil fuel power plants has destroyed the environment beyond repair. Solar energy used in the form of PV systems can help to meet the energy demand. One drawback faced by PV systems is their non-linear output as a result of non-uniform irradiance levels on it. This paper presents a Maximum Power Point Tracking control technique, that is, radial basis function network trained with differential annealed optimization algorithm. High optimization of DDAO combined with high precision of RBFN makes it an effective MPPT technique. Comparison is made with RBFN-PSO and RBFN-INC to check the performance of the proposed technique. Two cases are presented to validate the superior performance of RBFN-DDAO. Comparison showed that RBFN-DDAO tracks the global maxima with greater than 99.93% efficiency and 11\pmbms faster tracking time under fast varying irradiance and partial shading condition. The analysis of statistical data has also been exhibited to examine the robustness and responsiveness of the technique presented.
